title: 第17章 你这是欠了多少灵债第18章 闲话筑基与蛮荒土著
content_zh:
【7级·沼鳞蟒（红名）】
【血量95%】
巨蟒头颅上伤口看着吓人，实则未伤及根本，血量几乎无损。这一击反而激发了它的凶性。
粗壮尾部裹挟腥风与泥浆，朝众人横扫而来。
楚墨反应迅速，早已捻好的踏尘术瞬间激发，身形鬼魅般消失在原地，几个闪身便退到数丈之外，险险避开这凌厉一击。
朱鸣羽扇急挥，一股旋风托着苏瑶向后飘退。唯有赢乐反应稍慢，虽竭力闪避，仍被巨蟒尾尖擦到胸口。
“砰！”
他如同断线风筝般被抽飞，重重砸入灌木丛之中。
“赢兄弟！”张猛惊呼一声，连忙上前查看。
“咳咳，我没事。”赢乐灰头土脸地钻出，手上灵戒氤氲生光，撑起淡蓝色光幕护住周身。
此时他脸上满是后怕，若不是这枚护身灵戒及时激发，刚才那一下足以让他筋断骨折，失去战力。
“孽畜受死！”张猛见同伴无恙，怒吼一声，浑身肌肉贲张，挥拳便朝蟒身砸去！
他修炼的功法乃是《万象宝身诀》，肉身实力尤为强悍，一身筋骨可并肩金石。
“铛！”
然而拳头砸在鳞片上，竟发出金铁交鸣之声，只留下淡淡白痕，蟒蛇吃痛，身躯一扭，反而将张猛逼退。
朱鸣的风刃、苏瑶的水箭接连击中蟒身，却都难以破开那层坚韧的鳞甲，只能留下些浅伤，收效甚微。
楚墨眉头紧锁，这沼鳞蟒肉身强悍异常，他们的攻击如同刮痧。
在这开阔地带，它凭借庞大身躯占尽优势。长久缠斗下去，一旦真炁耗尽或是引来其他蛮兽，处境会很危险。
至于动用赤阳针或者‘柳师’？还没到山穷水尽的地步，不值得暴露底牌。
“不要和它硬拼！我们走！”心思电转间，楚墨当机立断，厉声喝道。

眼见沼鳞蟒再次张开血盆大口，腥风扑面地袭向自己。
他手诀变幻，数条灵力青藤破土而出，借助此地充沛的水木之炁，比往常更粗壮几分，死死缠住巨蟒行动。
“快退！”赢乐会意，挥手凝出三道冰剑，直射巨蟒眼睛，逼迫对方偏头闪避。
众人抓紧机会，迅速撤离。
一行人且战且退，朝着来时的密林深处疾驰。
然而，那沼鳞蟒竟如附骨之疽，甩动着庞大的身躯，生生在林中碾压出一条通道，死死追在后面，速度丝毫不慢于众人。
“这畜生怎么追这么紧？！”赢乐回头，一道【冰寒术】打出，减缓巨蟒速度。
楚墨心中也是暗骂，自己一行人已经跑出十数公里，对方依旧穷追不舍。
这要是在游戏里，早就脱战了。就算是现实中，野兽也有领地概念，一般情况也不会脱离自己地盘。
就在这时，赢乐眼睛一亮，仿佛抓住救命稻草，急声道：“我想起来了！来时的路上，我见过一处毒爪猴的聚集地，猴群数量不少。
我们把这家伙引过去，让它们狗咬狗！不，是猴斗蟒！”
“不可！”楚墨立刻出言否决，“这样会使我们被猴群与蟒蛇夹击。”
content_en:
[Level 7·Swamp Scale Python (red name)]
[HP 95%]
The wound on the python's head looked scary, but in fact it didn't cause any damage at all, and its blood volume was almost intact. This blow only stimulated its ferocity.
The thick tail carried the fishy wind and mud, and swept towards the crowd.
Chu Mo reacted quickly, and the dust-walking technique he had already mastered was instantly activated, and his figure disappeared from the spot like a ghost. He ducked and retreated several feet away, narrowly avoiding this sharp blow.
Zhu Ming's feather fan waved rapidly, and a whirlwind carried Su Yao backwards. Only Ying Le reacted a little slower. Although he tried his best to dodge, he was still brushed against the chest by the tail tip of the giant python.
"Bang!"
He was whipped away like a kite with its string cut off, and slammed into the bushes.
"Brother Win!" Zhang Meng exclaimed and quickly stepped forward to check.
"Ahem, I'm fine." Ying Le came out with a look of disgrace, the spiritual ring in his hand glowed, and he held up a light blue light curtain to protect his whole body.
At this moment, his face was full of fear. If the protective spiritual ring hadn't been activated in time, the blow just now was enough to break his muscles and bones and lose his fighting ability.
"Death to you evil beast!" Zhang Meng roared angrily when he saw that his companion was safe. His muscles all over his body were tense, and he punched the python with his fist!
The technique he practices is the "Ten Thousand Elements Treasure Body Technique". His physical strength is particularly strong, and his muscles and bones can stand shoulder to shoulder with gold and stone.
"Cang!"
However, when the fist hit the scales, it made a sound of gold and iron, leaving only a faint white mark. The python was in pain and twisted its body, forcing Zhang Meng back.
Zhu Ming's wind blade and Su Yao's water arrow hit the python's body one after another, but they were unable to break through the tough scales and could only leave some shallow injuries, with little effect.
Chu Mo frowned. The swamp scale python's body was extremely strong, and their attacks were like scraping.
In this open area, it has an advantage with its huge body. If the fight continues for a long time, once the true energy is exhausted or other beasts are attracted, the situation will be very dangerous.
As for using Chiyang Needle or ‘Liu Master’? We are not at the end of our rope yet, and it is not worth exposing our trump card.
"Don't fight it head-on! Let's go!" With his mind spinning, Chu Mo made a quick decision and shouted sternly.
Seeing the swamp-scaled python open its bloody mouth again, the fishy wind hit him.
His hand techniques changed, and several spiritual ivy sprouted out of the ground. With the help of the abundant energy of water and wood in this place, they became a little stronger than usual, and tightly wrapped around the giant python.
"Quickly retreat!" Ying Le understood, waved his hand and formed three ice swords, hitting the giant python's eyes directly, forcing the opponent to turn his head to dodge.
Everyone seized the opportunity and evacuated quickly.
The group of people fought and retreated, speeding towards the depths of the dense forest from whence they came.
However, the swamp-scaled python was like a gangrene attached to its bones, swinging its huge body, crushing a passage through the forest, and chasing after it, its speed was not slower than the others.
"Why is this beast chasing so closely?!" Ying Le turned around and fired a [Ice-Cold Technique] to slow down the giant python.
Chu Mo was also cursing secretly in his heart. He and his group had already run more than ten kilometers, and the other party was still chasing after them.
If this was in the game, it would have been out of the battle a long time ago. Even in reality, wild beasts have territorial concepts and generally will not leave their own territory.
At this moment, Ying Le's eyes lit up, as if grasping a life-saving straw, he said urgently: "I remembered! On the way here, I saw a gathering place of poison-clawed monkeys, and there were quite a few monkeys.
Let's lure this guy over and make them dog eat dog! No, it’s a monkey fighting a python! "
"No!" Chu Mo immediately objected, "This will cause us to be attacked by monkeys and pythons."
